science.title: Focus, from two angles
science.text: We stacked functional mushrooms with proven nootropics. Lion's Mane and cordyceps support brain health and clean energy, while Alpha-GPC feeds acetylcholine — your brain's focus chemical — and L-tyrosine supports dopamine under pressure. Add B12 for mental fuel, deliver it as a fast-absorbing tincture, and you've got cognition support that works.

format.title: Focus in a few drops
format.text: No capsules to swallow, no powders to mix. One dropper of naturally-flavoured tincture under the tongue — fast-absorbing cognition support you can take anywhere.

facts.side_title: A clean tincture for clearer thinking
facts.side_text: Lion's Mane and cordyceps mushroom extracts plus Alpha-GPC, L-tyrosine and 500 mcg of B12, in a glycerin base sweetened with stevia. Vegan and alcohol-free. Made in the USA — 1 fl oz / 30 ml, 30 servings.

items.a: Squeeze one full dropper (1 ml) under your tongue and hold for about 20 seconds, or add it to a drink. Once a day, ideally in the morning.

items.q: How is it different from the Lion's Mane capsules?
items.a: These drops stack Lion's Mane with cordyceps, Alpha-GPC, L-tyrosine and B12 for broader, faster-acting focus and energy support — and absorb quickly as a tincture.
Yes — a vegan, alcohol-free glycerin tincture sweetened with stevia.

items.q: Will it keep me up at night?
items.a: There's no caffeine — the energy comes from cordyceps and B12. Most people take it earlier in the day for focus, but it won't act like a stimulant.

items.q: When will I notice a difference?
items.a: Some feel the focus support quickly; the deeper mushroom benefits build over 4–8 weeks of daily use.
